gizmo.title: Dhayagiramu kubva pamavara
gizmo.description: Nyora dhayagiramu semavara (Mermaid): flowchart, sequence, timeline nezvimwe. Inodhirowewa mupeji ine imwe nzira yemavara.

configure.title: Musoro
configure.description: Inoratidzwa pamusoro pedhayagiramu uye inoshandiswa sezita rayo.

configure.title: Kodhi yedhayagiramu
configure.description: Mavara eMermaid, semuenzaniso: flowchart TD, wobva wanyora mutsara mumwe pa link yakaita sa A[Draft] --> B{Ready?}. Wedzera |label| mushure memuseve kuti uupe zita. Mufananidzo unogadziridzwa paunonyora.

configure.title: Imwe nzira yemavara
configure.description: Tsanangura zvinoratidzwa nedhayagiramu kuvanhu vasingagoni kuiona. Siya pasina chinhu paflowchart kuti matanho ayo anyorwe kwauri.

configure.title: Ratidza imwe nzira yemavara
configure.description: Ratidza imwe nzira yemavara pasi pemufananidzo. Inogara iripo kuvaverengi veskrini.

advanced.title: Faira rekodhi
advanced.description: Kero yefaira re.mmd rekudhirowa panzvimbo pemavara ari pamusoro (https kana nzira pasaiti iyi).
